title: HELIX Terminology: Payment Status
description: Status of vendor payments, refunds, and disbursements in the accounts payable process.

codes.definition: Payment request received but not yet approved or scheduled. Awaiting department approval, budget check, or documentation review.
Payment approved through all required authorization levels. Queued for the next payment cycle.
Payment approved and included in an upcoming payment batch. Payment date and method (check, ACH, wire) assigned.
Payment issued to the payee. For checks: printed and mailed/distributed. For ACH/wire: transmitted to the bank. Payment number and date recorded.

Payment cancelled after issuance but before clearing. For checks: stop payment issued. Creates a reversing entry against the original payment. Requires re-issuance if the underlying obligation remains.
Payment request cancelled before issuance. The voucher or payment request is closed. Budget and encumbrance may be released.
Payment returned by the bank (ACH return, uncashed check). Common reasons: incorrect account number, closed account, deceased payee. Triggers re-investigation and re-issuance.
Only a portion of the invoiced amount has been paid. Remaining balance is open. Common for progress payments on contracts, partial shipments on POs, or payment disputes.
Payment approved but intentionally held from disbursement. Reasons: vendor dispute, W-9 not on file, missing tax ID, debarred vendor flag, or 1099 compliance issue.
